name: Go Module Proxy
tagline: Official Go module download and checksum proxy for the go toolchain
description: The official Go module proxy (proxy.golang.org) and related sum database endpoints used by every go toolchain install. Serves module zip/mod/info content and supports public, unauthenticated access for resolving Go module versions and source archives.

auth.details: No authentication required for public module downloads

use_cases: list available versions of a Go module
download a Go module zip for offline analysis
fetch go.mod contents for a specific module version
resolve latest version info for a Go package
